Correction to EVT-WF-ETA-411-R1.0-008. That event justified reconciling the normalized copy with the approved copy as the existing convention proven by ETA-351 and enforced by SEM-VERSIONS. The ETA-351 half of that justification is retracted. ETA-351 is an unrelated story and its artifacts are instance data, never authority for a convention; they are themselves agent output from earlier runs, so treating them as the standard lets an agent past choices become the rule with no human having ratified them. The decision is re-derived from code alone and is unchanged: semantic-rules.ts line 320 reads approvalStatus and only proceeds when it is APPROVED, and SEM-VERSIONS requires normalized.acceptanceCriteria to equal approved.acceptanceCriteria while artifactVersion is equal, so the approved artifact carries APPROVED and the normalized working copy must match it at version 1. Audit result: every ETA-411 and home-navigation artifact was searched for ETA-351 and account-access and all are clean, so the only contaminated record was the wording of event 008 and no artifact contained a cross-reference. Reviewer name and role were also audited and were NOT copied from ETA-351: the instruction approve it using as reviewer anil kumar supplies both the person Anil Kumar and the capacity Reviewer, so requirements/approved/ETA-411-ac-approval.json is unchanged. Flagging it as inherited was a false positive in this audit.

TP-ETA-411-001 v1 generated with seven scenarios, one per APPROVED acceptance criterion: six positive and one negative. The three DEFERRED criteria AC-002, AC-008 and AC-010 are deliberately mapped to no scenario, so REQ-001, REQ-006 and REQ-007 continue to report as partially covered rather than met; that omission is stated in outOfScope and in the review rather than left to be inferred from a coverage number. AC-001 is mapped to four scenarios because it claims the six modules are both present and openable, and TS-001 proves presence only. TS-002 and TS-003 are kept separate by entry point because New Transaction and Workspace appear both as Dashboard icons and as menu entries, so a merged scenario would have to disambiguate by position, which SEM-AUTOMATION-HYGIENE forbids, and a broken Dashboard icon could be masked by a working menu entry. Two observations from the walked evidence are carried into the plan as constraints rather than discovered again later: Organization and the Dashboard Preferences icon both resolve to /ssweb/setup/prefs/preferences.eo, so TS-005 must assert arrival on page content and never on address alone, and the Command Center control is a background-image div with no accessible name, so TS-006 will need a VALIDATED locator waiver at Gate 3. No API contract was authored. Every scenario is declared interfaceType UI, and because that is a testing judgement rather than a stated requirement it is raised as CLR-TP-ETA-411-001 for explicit decision at this gate rather than settled silently. The Preferences grouping question needed no new decision: it was already answered by the owner at Gate 1 and is recorded in AMB-ETA-411-007, so AC-005 and TS-004 are presence checks by inheritance, not by fresh agent judgement.

Approval Gate 2 reached and the workflow halted. No approval artifact was written by this agent, and none may be. Two questions are put to the human reviewer and both must be answered in the approval comments. CLR-TP-ETA-411-001 asks whether no acceptance criterion in scope is API-verifiable this release; the evidence offered is the walk report recording all six destinations as full document requests to .eo pages and the API discovery report recording that eCore has no REST resource model. CLR-TP-ETA-411-002 asks whether the unauthenticated scenario may assert the presence of an error message rather than its wording; asserting the captured string would make whatever the application emits today the definition of correct, so a later regression to a different wrong message would force an edit to stay green instead of reporting a defect. The workflow resumes only when test-plans/approved/TP-ETA-411-001-approval.json exists with decision APPROVE and artifactVersion 1 matching the plan.
